name: phd-defense-after-the-eight-year-limit
description: Red-team 2026-09-13: §4.3 — "Failure to complete all requirements for the Ph.D. degree within eight (8) years results in forfeiture of degree eligibility." A student who entered Fall 2026 and defended in January 2036 used to read "met" on the defense row AND "All requirements are complete within the 8-year limit" on the time-limit row, because the dissertation rows were plain booleans with no date logic and the time-limit row asks only whether the other rows are met. The defense now goes to the DGS, and the time-limit row follows.
